notes.title: NiGHT SIGNAL Development News
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=FHe7pS56QjM;full][/previewyoutube]
Nick here! The sole programmer, artist and writer of NiGHT SIGNAL. This past year has been a productive one for NiGHT SIGNAL's development, and I'm pleased to announce that the game has entered its BETA phase of development, with the core mechanics, structure, combat and atmosphere in place. The game is coming along well now as I enter into the testing and polish stage, and I anticipate a release window and trailer sometime during Q1 2021.

To give you something to chew on for now, I have uploaded one of the game's original music pieces, composed by my good friend and collaborator David Johnsen. The game's atmosphere attempts to strike a balance between classic 90's survival horror and the unique soundscapes of [i]The Twilight Zone[/i]. I hope you enjoy this little taste, and keep your eyes peeled for a trailer and release date soon.
[i]
This concludes this evening's broadcast.[/i]
